quotes.quote: When you must, you can.
quotes.author: Rabbi Steve Leder

quotes.quote: Every little action of the common day makes or unmakes character.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: When what you hear and what you see don't match, trust your eyes.
quotes.author: Dale Renton

quotes.quote: It's the best, Jerry, the best!
quotes.author: Bania in The Sein

quotes.quote: Give people a common enemy and you will give them a common identity. Deprive them of an enemy and you will deprive them of the crutch by which they know who they are.
quotes.author: James Alison

quotes.quote: One of the hallmarks of ego is defensiveness. It means that we stand guard at the gates of self, patrolling visitors, VIPs, intruders, everything. This is a very fragile way of living. That means that at any time, any person, anywhere, can do something destructive to my own inner environment. The move away from some of that defensiveness into a certain kind of acceptance, love, deeper understanding, is very important as we evolve ethically.
quotes.author: Matthew Brensilver

quotes.quote: Fear is a natural reaction to moving closer to the truth.
quotes.author: Pema Chodron

quotes.quote: All the water in the world can't sink the ship unless it gets inside.
quotes.author: Zig Ziglar

quotes.quote: The first principle is that you must not fool yourself—and you are the easiest person to fool.
quotes.author: Richard Feynman

quotes.quote: It’s amazing how often a second try works.
quotes.author: Kevin Kelly

quotes.quote: As we express our gratitude, we must never forget that the highest appreciation is not to utter words, but to live by them.
quotes.author: JFK

quotes.quote: To every man is given the key to the gates of heaven. The same key opens the gates of hell.
quotes.author: Richard Feynman

quotes.quote: I must see God in the other; I must access God in myself; and I must experience God in a new way that is larger than an "enforcer".
quotes.author: Fater Richard Rohr

quotes.quote: The beginning of love is the will to let those we love be perfectly themselves, the resolution not to twist them to fit our own image. If in loving them we do not love what they are, but only their potential likeness to ourselves, then we do not love them: we only love the reflection of ourselves we find in them.
quotes.author: Thomas Merton

quotes.quote: The privilege of a lifetime is to become who you truly are.
quotes.author: Carl Jung

quotes.quote: Thinking is difficult, that's why most people judge.
quotes.author: Carl Jung

quotes.quote: There is within every soul a thirst for happiness and meaning
quotes.author: Saint Thomas Aquinas

quotes.quote: And you? When will you begin that long journey into yourself?
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.quote: I'm not here to be right, I'm here to get it right.
quotes.author: Brené Brown

quotes.quote: Silence is God’s first language.
quotes.author: Thomas Merton

quotes.quote: For me, to be a saint means to be myself.
quotes.author: Thomas Merton

quotes.quote: If you do not find the Beloved within yourself, you will build a temple to a mortal and demand they become your god. And when they fail—as they must—you will hate them for being human.
quotes.author: Sufi Teaching

quotes.quote: The way is long-let us go together.  The way is difficult-let us help each other.  The way is joyful-let us share it.  The way is our alone-let us go in love.
quotes.author: Joyce Hunter

quotes.quote: People are hard to hate close up.
quotes.author: Brené Brown

quotes.quote: O God, if I worship you in fear of hell, burn me in hell. If I worship you in hope of paradise, shut me out from paradise. But if I worship you for your own sake, do not withhold from me your everlasting beauty.
quotes.author: Rabia al-Adawiyya

quotes.quote: Self-transformation requires self-witnessing.
Give people light and they will find a way.
quotes.author: Ella Baker
